summary: Rename current-product Rust internals and generated schema presentation to Fractal

replay.detail: Source identifier, test name and documentation presentation changes only; claim projection and replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: Registry descriptions remain byte-identical compatibility data. Generated Markdown renders Fractal branding without changing the registry, storage version or digests.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, claim admission or fleet coordination rules change.

compatibility.detail: Rust driver API identifiers, KDL schema-version identifiers, TUI locals, test names and the paired TUI SLO thread checker/builder are renamed together. Plugin, marketplace, server and channel identities, delivery tags, envelope strings, serialized model values, environment names, executable aliases and persisted paths are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No runtime cutover or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: No migration or operator steps are required.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no state conversion; the wire and storage contracts are unchanged.
